Module net.automatalib.api
Package net.automatalib.ts.acceptor

Interface AcceptorTS<S,I>

Type Parameters:
S - state class
I - input symbol class
All Superinterfaces:
InitialStates<S>, Output<I,Boolean>, OutputTS<S,I,S,Boolean>, SimpleTS<S,I>, SuffixOutput<I,Boolean>, TransitionSystem<S,I,S>, UniversalTransitionSystem<S,I,S,Boolean,Void>
All Known Subinterfaces:
AcceptorPowersetViewTS<S,I,OS>, DeterministicAcceptorTS<S,I>, DFA<S,I>, FiniteStateAcceptor<S,I>, Lasso.DFALasso<I>, MutableDFA<S,I>, MutableFSA<S,I>, MutableNFA<S,I>, NFA<S,I>, SBA<S,I>, SPA<S,I>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractBricsAutomaton, AcceptorPowersetView, BricsDFA, BricsNFA, CompactDFA, CompactNFA, CompactNFA.CompactAcceptorPowersetDTS, DeterministicAcceptorPowersetView, DFALassoImpl, EmptySBA, EmptySPA, FastAcceptorPowersetDTS, FastDFA, FastNFA, SEVPASemantics, StackSBA, StackSPA
public interface AcceptorTS<S,I> extends UniversalTransitionSystem<S,I,S,Boolean,Void>, OutputTS<S,I,S,Boolean>, SuffixOutput<I,Boolean>
A transition system whose semantics are defined by whether a state is "accepting" or not.
